title: A particle resource: res/particles/<archive>/<member>/particles.json, or res/graphics/<archive>/<member>/particles.json
description: A particle resource (SPA) of ARCID_BTLV_EFFVM_PARTICLES (a/0/0/6), which btlv_effvm.c and intro_particle.c load, or of another archive: its emitters, which SPLManager_LoadResources reads and SPLManager_CreateEmitter creates by their index, and its textures, whose pixels are the PNGs beside it. Fields have lib/spl's names. tools/data/nitro_particles.py builds the resource from them for tools/data/graphics_archive.py, computing its header, its emitters' flags of the blocks they have, its texture animations' counts and its textures' headers. Fixed-point fields are the integers the game keeps: fx32 and fx16 in 4096ths, angles in 65536ths of a turn, and a particle's life, over which the animations run, from 0 to 255.

emitters.description: The resource's emitters (SPLResource), in order: each its header's fields (SPLResourceHeader), then the blocks that follow it, each only where the emitter has it

textures.description: The resource's textures, in order (SPLTextureResource), each its PNG, <name>.png, or for a format that isn't decoded its data as it is, <name>.bin

emissionType.description: Where particles start, relative to the emitter (SPL_EMISSION_*): circles and cylinders lie in the plane of the emitter's cross axes, hemispheres on the side their normal points to; circle_border_uniform spreads them evenly around the circle

emissionAxis.description: The axis the circles and cylinders of emission are around (SPL_AXIS_*): emitter for the emitter's axis

hasRotation.description: Turns the particles, each at an angular velocity from minRotation to maxRotation

randomInitAngle.description: Starts each particle at a random angle rather than at initAngle

autoTerminate.description: Deletes the emitter once it has emitted for its life time and its particles are gone

followEmitter.description: Moves the particles with the emitter after they are emitted

randomLoopOffset.description: Starts each particle's looped animations at a random point

drawChildrenFirst.description: Draws the child particles before their parents

relativeToBasePos.description: Draws the particles relative to the emitter's base position, translating them to it

fixedPolygonID.description: Gives the particles the manager's fixed polygon ID rather than a new one each

childFixedPolygonID.description: Gives the child particles the manager's fixed polygon ID rather than a new one each

emitterBasePos.description: Added to the position the emitter is created at, in 4096ths

emissionCount.description: The particles emitted each time, in 4096ths, the fraction carried to the next time

radius.description: The radius of the sphere, circle or cylinder of emission, in 4096ths

length.description: The length of the cylinder of emission, in 4096ths

color.description: The particles' color, which the color animation fades to and from

initVelPositionAmplifier.description: A particle's initial speed away from the emitter, in 4096ths, which velocityVariance varies

initVelAxisAmplifier.description: A particle's initial speed along the emitter's axis, in 4096ths, which velocityVariance varies

baseScale.description: The particles' scale, in 4096ths, which scaleVariance varies

aspectRatio.description: The particles' width over their height, in 4096ths

startDelay.description: The frames before the emitter starts

minRotation.description: The least angular velocity of a particle, in 65536ths of a turn a frame

maxRotation.description: The greatest angular velocity of a particle, in 65536ths of a turn a frame

initAngle.description: The particles' angle when emitted, in 65536ths of a turn

emitterLifeTime.description: The frames the emitter emits for, or 0 for as long as it lives

particleLifeTime.description: The frames a particle lives, which lifeTimeVariance varies

scaleVariance.description: How much of its scale a particle may lose at random, out of 255

lifeTimeVariance.description: How much of its life time a particle may lose at random, out of 255

velocityVariance.description: How much of its initial speed a particle may lose at random, out of 255

airResistance.description: The part of their velocity particles keep each frame, as 384 more than this out of 512

texture.description: The particles' texture, without a texture animation

loopTime.description: The frames of a looped animation

dirStretch.description: How much directional billboards stretch along their velocity as it turns across the view, in 4096ths

textureRepeatShiftS.description: The times the texture repeats across a particle, as a power of two

textureRepeatShiftT.description: The times the texture repeats down a particle, as a power of two

scaleAnimDir.description: The particles' axes that the scale animation scales (SPL_SCALE_ANIM_DIR_*)

dirFromPosition.description: Points directional polygons back along their position rather than along their velocity

polygonX.description: Where the polygon is drawn across from the particle, in 4096ths of its size

polygonY.description: Where the polygon is drawn up from the particle, in 4096ths of its size

unused.description: Fields the library doesn't read that the file doesn't leave 0: unk3a, unk43, unk54, and unk4c, the 30 bits after flipTextureT

scaleAnim.description: The animation of the particles' scale (SPLScaleAnim), over the axes of scaleAnimDir: from start to mid until in, mid until out, and to end from there

in.description: The point of the particle's life the fade from start ends at

out.description: The point of the particle's life the fade to end starts at

loop.description: Animates over loopTime rather than the particle's life

unused.description: unk8, the 15 bits after loop, and padding

colorAnim.description: The animation of the particles' color (SPLColorAnim): start until in, a fade from it to the emitter's color until peak and from that to end until out, then end

randomStart.description: Gives each particle one of the three colors at random, and doesn't animate it

loop.description: Animates over loopTime rather than the particle's life

interpolate.description: Fades between the colors, rather than changing at in, peak and out

unused.description: padding, unk8, the 13 bits after interpolate, and padding2

alphaAnim.description: The animation of the particles' alpha (SPLAlphaAnim), 0 to 31: from start to mid until in, mid until out, and to end from there

randomRange.description: How much of the alpha a particle may lose at random each frame, out of 255, which makes it flicker

loop.description: Animates over loopTime rather than the particle's life

unused.description: unk0, the bit after end, unk2, the 7 bits after loop, and padding2

textureAnim.description: The animation of the particles' texture (SPLTextureAnim): each texture in turn for step of the particle's life

step.description: The part of the particle's life, out of 255, that each texture shows for

randomStart.description: Gives each particle one of the textures at random, and doesn't animate it

loop.description: Animates over loopTime rather than the particle's life

childResource.description: The particles that each particle emits (SPLChildResource)

hasBehaviors.description: Applies the emitter's behaviors to the children too

hasScaleAnim.description: Scales the children from their scale to endScale over their life

hasAlphaAnim.description: Fades the children out over their life

rotationType.description: What the children take from their parent's rotation (SPL_CHILD_ROTATION_*)

followEmitter.description: Moves the children with the emitter after they are emitted

useChildColor.description: Gives the children their color, rather than their parent's

randomInitVelMag.description: Up to how much, in 4096ths, the children's velocities differ at random from their share of their parent's

endScale.description: The scale the children grow or shrink to over their life, in 4096ths

velocityRatio.description: The part of their parent's velocity the children start with, out of 256

scaleRatio.description: The part of their parent's scale the children start with, as one more than this out of 64

emissionCount.description: The children each particle emits each time

emissionDelay.description: The part of its life, out of 256, after which a particle emits children

emissionInterval.description: The frames between a particle's emissions of children

textureRepeatShiftS.description: The times the texture repeats across a child, as a power of two

textureRepeatShiftT.description: The times the texture repeats down a child, as a power of two

dirFromPosition.description: Points directional children back along their position rather than along their velocity

unused.description: unk0, the 4 bits after polygonReferencePlane, and unk10, the 25 bits after dirFromPosition

gravityBehavior.description: A constant force on the particles (SPLGravityBehavior)

magnitude.description: Added to a particle's velocity each frame, in 4096ths

randomBehavior.description: A random force on the particles (SPLRandomBehavior)

magnitude.description: Up to how much, either way, the force is on each axis, in 4096ths

magnetBehavior.description: A pull of the particles towards a point (SPLMagnetBehavior)

target.description: The point, relative to the emitter, in 4096ths

force.description: The part of the way to the target from where a particle is headed that is added to its velocity each frame, in 4096ths

spinBehavior.description: A turn of the particles' positions about the emitter (SPLSpinBehavior)

angle.description: The turn each frame, in 65536ths of a turn

collisionPlaneBehavior.description: A plane that particles crossing it die at or bounce off (SPLCollisionPlaneBehavior)

y.description: The plane's height, in 4096ths, unless the emitter's collision plane height overrides it

elasticity.description: The part of its vertical speed a bouncing particle keeps, in 4096ths

type.description: What a particle crossing it does (SPL_COLLISION_*)

convergenceBehavior.description: A pull of the particles' positions straight towards a point (SPLConvergenceBehavior)

target.description: The point, relative to the emitter, in 4096ths

force.description: The part of the way to the target a particle moves each frame, in 4096ths

texture.description: A texture (SPLTextureResource and its SPLTextureParam). Its size is its PNG's, a power of two from 8 to 1024 each way; its palette grows to the colors an edited PNG needs, up to its format's

name.description: Its file's name, without the extension, by which the emitters name it

format.description: Its format (GXTexFmt): a3i5 and a5i3 a palette's index and an alpha a texel, palette4 to palette256 an index, direct an RGB555 color and an alpha bit. compressed4x4 and none aren't decoded: their texture is its data as it is

flip.description: The directions it flips in as it repeats (GXTexFlip)

palColor0.description: Makes a palette format's color 0 clear: the PNG's pixels clear where they are

sharedTexture.description: The texture whose VRAM it uses rather than uploading its own (useSharedTexture and sharedTexID)

width.description: For a texture that isn't decoded, its width

height.description: For a texture that isn't decoded, its height

drawType.description: How particles are drawn (SPL_DRAW_*): as billboards facing the camera, or polygons in the plane of the emitter's cross axes, either way stretched along their velocity if directional

polygonRotAxis.description: The axis polygons turn about with their rotation: y, or the diagonal (1, 1, 1)

polygonReferencePlane.description: The plane polygons are drawn in

unused.description: The bits of a block that the library never reads, by their field's name in lib/spl (or unk and their word's offset, for unnamed bits, as a number of those bits), where the game's file doesn't leave them 0; the packer writes 0 for the rest

color.description: A color, 0 to 31 for each component
